text: The purpose of this report is to provide the Board with a general status update, as well as a report on the second quarter activities of the three theatres (Sony Centre for the Performing Arts, St. Lawrence Centre for the Arts, Toronto Centre for the Arts).

The Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto: 1. Received the report (August 31, 2018) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, Civic Theatres Toronto and Confidential Attachment 1 for information. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (August 31, 2018) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, Civic Theatres Toronto remain confidential in its entirety, as it involves the security of property belonging to the Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto.
